Project Brief

Bookslab Online Bookstore (Personal project | October 2024)

Using Figma to design an online bookstore that not only sells books, but also office utilities and useful gifts for your family and friends.
What I learnt: Through this project, I was able to explore how to use different functions in Figma like creating variables, components, prototyping and discovered my interest in UX/UI and Web design industry.
